items.heading: Phone not charging
precautionsFirst: Do not use a damaged cable or charger that shows fraying or exposed wires.
details: Try a different cable and charging adapter to isolate the problem.
Gently clean the charging port with a dry, soft brush or a toothpick to remove lint and dust, with the phone off.
Check the cable for visible damage and replace it if frayed.
Restart the phone after connecting the charger, as software can sometimes misreport charging status.
If none of this works, the charging port itself may need professional repair.

items.heading: Slow laptop or computer
precautionsFirst: Save any open work before restarting or closing heavy programs.
details: Restart the device, which clears temporary memory buildup.
Close unnecessary background programs and browser tabs.
Free up storage space by deleting unused files and clearing the downloads folder.
Check for pending software and operating system updates and install them.
Scan for malware using a trusted antivirus tool if the slowdown is sudden and unexplained.

items.heading: Wi-Fi router troubleshooting
precautionsFirst: Wait at least 30 seconds between switching the router off and on, to let it fully reset.
details: Restart the router and modem by switching them off, waiting 30 seconds, and turning them back on.
Check all cables are firmly connected at both ends.
Move the router to a central, open location, away from thick walls and other electronics.
Check for firmware updates through the router's app or admin page.
Restart the connecting device if only that device is affected.

items.heading: Printer not printing
precautionsFirst: Do not force jammed paper out roughly - pull it gently in the direction of the paper path.
details: Check the printer is powered on, connected, and set as the default printer on your device.
Check ink or toner levels and the paper tray for jams or an empty tray.
Clear any paper jam by gently pulling the paper in its natural feed direction after opening the access panel.
Run the printer's built-in cleaning or alignment utility from its settings menu if print quality is poor.
Restart both the printer and the connected device if it still fails.

items.heading: Phone screen unresponsive or frozen
precautionsFirst: Avoid pressing forcefully on a cracked screen, which can worsen the damage.
details: Perform a force restart using the button combination specific to your phone model.
Remove the screen protector or case temporarily in case it is interfering with touch sensitivity.
Clean the screen gently with a dry microfiber cloth.
If the issue persists after a restart, back up your data and consult a technician, as it may be a hardware fault.

items.heading: Bluetooth device not pairing
precautionsFirst: Keep both devices within close range, under a meter apart, during initial pairing.
details: Turn Bluetooth off and on again on both devices.
Make sure the accessory is in pairing or discoverable mode.
Remove, or forget, the device from Bluetooth settings and pair again from scratch.
Restart both devices if pairing still fails.
Check the accessory is charged, since low battery can prevent proper pairing.

items.heading: Laptop overheating
precautionsFirst: Always let a laptop cool and power it off before opening any vents to clean, and never use it on a soft surface like a bed that blocks the vents.
details: Use a can of compressed air to clean dust out of the vents and fan area, with the laptop off and unplugged.
Use the laptop on a hard, flat surface that allows air to flow underneath, or use a cooling pad.
Close unnecessary heavy applications running in the background.
Check the fan is spinning audibly under load - if silent, it might need professional servicing.
